explanation: The polynomial Bogolyubov conjecture over F₂ⁿ: there is an absolute C such that for every nonempty A of density α, 10A contains a coset of a subspace of dimension ≥ n − C·log₂(1/α). This is a faithful rendering of "dimension at least n − O(log(1/α))". With Pointwise open, `10 • A` on a Finset is Mathlib's iterated sumset (per the note on pointwise ℕ-actions), not dilation, which matches the docstring. A dilation reading would make 10A = {0} in characteristic 2. The statement is faithful and open.
